title: How Killing It Out Loud Ends the Sin a Godly Man Keeps Losing To
caption:
You've been managing the same sin for years. Managing isn't killing it.

Scripture doesn't say wrestle it into a corner. It says put it to death.

Confess your sins to one another, that you may be healed (James 5:16). Not the group chat. One brother who already knows your worst week.

One confession isn't the finish. It's the first rep. Expect the pull to come back, do it again tomorrow, and let the relief prove God's finishing what He started.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #confession #discipline
